title: test(types): ensure correct signature
body:
**Summary**

Add a test and fix the signature of createHitsComponent. The test ensures:

* export of ui component is a function
* function has correct name
* type of the return is a function
* return type has only one parameter, which is just a name

**Result**

* No reproduction of https://github.com/algolia/ui-components/pull/29 in this code base
* test based on https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/wiki/Using-the-Compiler-API#traversing-the-ast-with-a-little-linter (I think this could be eslint as well, but that was harder to understand. We can migrate later with basically the same logic, or continue using this TS test/linter as it is based on the output, not the input)
